lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab janam ham tumhre sevak ab tau mitiaa na jaaee ||
lines.translation: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tere duaarai dhun sahaj kee maathai mere dagaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਗੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ ਭਗਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daage hohi s ran mahi joojhahi bin daage bhag jaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Your brand run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo hoi s bhagat pachhaanai har lae khajaanai paaee ||3||
lines.translation: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to the Lord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਠਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kothare mahi kotharee param kothee beechaar ||
lines.translation: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supreme chamber.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur deenee basat kabeer kau levahu basat samhaar ||4||
lines.translation: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, "Take this commodity; cherish it and keep it secure." ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਦੀਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer deeee sa(n)saar kau leenee jis masatak bhaag ||
lines.translation: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras jin paaiaa thir taa kaa sohaag ||5||4||
lines.translation: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih mukh bed gaaitree nikasai so kiu brahaman bisar karai ||
lines.translation: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai paai jagat sabh laagai so kiu pa(n)dit har na kahai ||1||
lines.translation: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮੑਨ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe mere baamhn har na kahahi ||
lines.translation: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam na bolahi paade dojak bharahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan ooch neech ghar bhojan hathe karam kar udar bharahi ||
lines.translation: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fill up your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਸ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chaudas amaavas rach rach maa(n)gahi kar deepak lai koop parahi ||2||
lines.translation: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; even though you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) brahaman mai kaaseek julahaa muhi tohi baraabaree kaise kai banahi ||
lines.translation: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hamare raam naam kahi ubare bed bharose paa(n)de doob marahi ||3||5||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, you shall drown and die. ||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taravar ek ana(n)t daar saakhaa puhap patr ras bhareeaa ||
lines.translation: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ih a(n)mrit kee baaRee hai re tin har poorai kareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanee jaanee re raajaa raam kee kahaanee ||
lines.translation: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot raam paragaasaa guramukh biralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by the Lord's Light. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavar ek puhap ras beedhaa baarah le ur dhariaa ||
lines.translation: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it in the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਹ ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੇ ਫਰੁ ਫਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sorah madhe pavan jhakoriaa aakaase phar phariaa ||2||
lines.translation: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, and beats his wings in esctasy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj su(n)n ik biravaa upajiaa dharatee jalahar sokhiaa ||
lines.translation: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up the water of desire from the ground.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer hau taa kaa sevak jin ihu biravaa dekhiaa ||3||6||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)draa mon daiaa kar jholee patr kaa karahu beechaar re ||
lines.translation: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)thaa ihu tan seeau apanaa naam karau aadhaar re ||1||
lines.translation: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa jog kamaavahu jogee ||
lines.translation: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam guramukh bhogee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: budh bibhoot chadhaavau apunee si(n)gee surat milaaee ||
lines.translation: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar bairaag phirau tan nagaree man kee ki(n)guree bajaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat lai hiradai raakhahu rahai niraalam taaRee ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deep meditative trance be undisturbed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾੜੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu dharam daiaa kar baaRee ||3||7||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden. ||3||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kaaj siraje jag bheetar janam kavan phal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhav nidh taran taaran chi(n)taaman ik nimakh na ihu man laaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1||
